adjudication.rationale: In `parseRefreshTokenResponse` when credential-sync is enabled it uses `minimumTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(response)` (no `.passthrough()`), so any fields not explicitly in the schema are stripped from `data`. Since `minimumTokenResponseSchema` does not include `refresh_token`, the function then forcibly sets `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"`. Call sites then persist/propagate that minimized `data` back into stored credentials (e.g. Office365 spreads `tokenResponse.data` into `o365AuthCredentials`, overwriting the real refresh token; Google persists `key` from `parseRefreshTokenResponse(...)` into `prisma.credential.update`). This can cause data loss/broken refresh behavior by replacing the actual refresh token and dropping other credential fields.
